meanings.en: to or at the greatest distance
meanings.exampleEn: She lives farthest from the school of all her friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm arkadaşları arasında okula en uzak olan o yaşıyor.

meanings.en: to attract and hold someone's interest strongly
meanings.exampleEn: Ancient history continues to fascinate me.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik tarih beni büyülemeye devam ediyor.

meanings.en: popular or stylish at a particular time
meanings.exampleEn: She always wears fashionable clothes.
meanings.exampleTr: O her zaman moda kıyafetler giyer.

meanings.en: to close or join something firmly
meanings.exampleEn: Please fasten your seatbelt before takeoff.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen kalkıştan önce emniyet kemerinizi bağlayın.

meanings.en: showing approval or being advantageous
meanings.exampleEn: The weather conditions were favorable for sailing.
meanings.exampleTr: Hava koşulları yelken yapmak için elverişliydi.

meanings.en: a copy of a document sent electronically over a phone line
meanings.exampleEn: I sent the contract to them by fax this morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmeyi bu sabah onlara faksla gönderdim.

meanings.en: a large special meal for many people
meanings.exampleEn: They prepared a huge feast for the wedding.
meanings.exampleTr: Düğün için kocaman bir ziyafet hazırladılar.

meanings.en: a boat that carries people and vehicles across water
meanings.exampleEn: We took the ferry across the river to the old town.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski şehre gitmek için nehri feribotla geçtik.

meanings.en: relating to a celebration or cheerful occasion
meanings.exampleEn: The streets had a festive atmosphere during the holidays.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatil boyunca sokaklarda şenlikli bir hava vardı.

meanings.en: to go and bring back something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: Could you fetch me a glass of water?
meanings.exampleTr: Bana bir bardak su getirebilir misin?

meanings.en: in a very fast and excited or anxious way
meanings.exampleEn: They worked feverishly to finish before the deadline.
meanings.exampleTr: Son tarihten önce bitirmek için telaşla çalıştılar.

meanings.en: one of five equal parts of something
meanings.exampleEn: Only a fifth of the students passed the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrencilerin yalnızca beşte biri sınavı geçti.

meanings.en: the food or material put inside something
meanings.exampleEn: This pie has a delicious apple filling.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu turtanın içi enfes elma dolgusu.

meanings.en: a person who makes films
meanings.exampleEn: The young film-maker won an award for her documentary.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç film yapımcısı belgeseliyle bir ödül kazandı.

meanings.en: a device that removes unwanted things from a liquid or gas
meanings.exampleEn: You should change the water filter every month.
meanings.exampleTr: Su filtresini her ay değiştirmelisin.

meanings.en: relating to money or finance
meanings.exampleEn: The company is facing serious financial problems.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket ciddi mali sorunlarla karşı karşıya.

meanings.en: a result or piece of information discovered by research
meanings.exampleEn: The main finding of the study surprised the researchers.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışmanın temel bulgusu araştırmacıları şaşırttı.

meanings.en: a building where firefighters and fire engines are based
meanings.exampleEn: There is a fire station near our neighborhood.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahallemizin yakınında bir itfaiye binası var.

meanings.en: a person whose job is to put out fires
meanings.exampleEn: The brave firefighter rescued a child from the burning house.
meanings.exampleTr: Cesur itfaiyeci yanan evden bir çocuğu kurtardı.

meanings.en: a device that explodes with colorful lights and sound
meanings.exampleEn: A single firework lit up the entire night sky.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek bir havai fişek tüm gece gökyüzünü aydınlattı.

meanings.en: solid, strong, or not easily changed
meanings.exampleEn: The mattress is too firm for me to sleep on.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatak benim üzerinde uyumam için fazla sert.

meanings.en: in a strong, steady, or determined way
meanings.exampleEn: He firmly refused to change his decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararını değiştirmeyi kararlılıkla reddetti.

meanings.en: the floor of a building at or just above ground level
meanings.exampleEn: Her office is on the first floor of the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun ofisi binanın birinci katında.

meanings.en: the wife of a president or head of state
meanings.exampleEn: The first lady gave a speech about children's education.
meanings.exampleTr: First lady çocukların eğitimi hakkında bir konuşma yaptı.

meanings.en: located on the first floor
meanings.exampleEn: They rented a first-floor apartment with a small balcony.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük balkonu olan birinci kat bir daire kiraladılar.

meanings.en: the condition of being physically healthy and strong
meanings.exampleEn: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
meanings.exampleTr: Düzenli egzersiz formunu geliştirir.

meanings.en: happening suddenly and for a very short time
meanings.exampleEn: The store announced a flash sale lasting only two hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza yalnızca iki saat süren anlık bir indirim duyurdu.

meanings.en: smooth and level, without curves or bumps
meanings.exampleEn: We need a flat surface to set up the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Masayı kurmak için düz bir yüzeye ihtiyacımız var.

meanings.en: the particular taste of a food or drink
meanings.exampleEn: This ice cream has a strong vanilla flavor.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu dondurmanın güçlü bir vanilya aroması var.

meanings.en: a group of birds or sheep together
meanings.exampleEn: A flock of birds flew over the field.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir kuş sürüsü tarlanın üzerinden uçtu.

meanings.en: a steady continuous movement of something
meanings.exampleEn: The dam controls the flow of the river.
meanings.exampleTr: Baraj nehrin akışını kontrol eder.

meanings.en: an illness like a bad cold, causing fever and aches
meanings.exampleEn: She stayed home because she had the flu.
meanings.exampleTr: Grip olduğu için evde kaldı.

meanings.en: in a smooth and easy way, especially speaking a language
meanings.exampleEn: She speaks three languages fluently.
meanings.exampleTr: Üç dili akıcı bir şekilde konuşuyor.

meanings.en: to fail a test or course
meanings.exampleEn: He was afraid he would flunk the math exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Matematik sınavından kalacağından korkuyordu.

meanings.en: a musical wind instrument played by blowing across a hole
meanings.exampleEn: She has played the flute since she was a child.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukluğundan beri flüt çalıyor.

meanings.en: a line or mark made by bending something over itself
meanings.exampleEn: Make a sharp fold in the paper along the line.
meanings.exampleTr: Kâğıtta çizgi boyunca keskin bir kıvrım yap.

meanings.en: people in general, especially of a particular group
meanings.exampleEn: The local folk were very friendly to the tourists.
meanings.exampleTr: Yöre halkı turistlere karşı çok cana yakındı.

meanings.en: having a great liking for someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She is very fond of her grandchildren.
meanings.exampleTr: Torunlarına çok düşkün.

meanings.en: a strong liking or affection for something
meanings.exampleEn: He has a great fondness for old jazz music.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski caz müziğine büyük bir düşkünlüğü var.

meanings.en: silly or showing a lack of good sense
meanings.exampleEn: It was foolish to drive so fast in the rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmurda bu kadar hızlı araba sürmek aptalcaydı.

meanings.en: not allowed, especially by a rule or law
meanings.exampleEn: Smoking is strictly forbidden inside the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Binanın içinde sigara içmek kesinlikle yasaktır.

meanings.en: the part of the face above the eyes
meanings.exampleEn: She wiped the sweat from her forehead.
meanings.exampleTr: Alnındaki teri sildi.

meanings.en: to stop being angry at someone for a mistake or wrong
meanings.exampleEn: Please forgive me for being so late.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar geç kaldığım için lütfen beni affet.

meanings.en: following official rules or suitable for serious occasions
meanings.exampleEn: You must wear formal clothes to the ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Törene resmi kıyafet giymelisin.

meanings.en: in an official or formal manner
meanings.exampleEn: The agreement was formally signed by both leaders.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşma her iki lider tarafından resmen imzalandı.

meanings.en: the way something is arranged or presented
meanings.exampleEn: The report follows a clear and simple format.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor açık ve basit bir biçim izliyor.

meanings.en: happening or existing before the present time
meanings.exampleEn: The former president gave a speech at the event.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski başkan etkinlikte bir konuşma yaptı.

meanings.en: a rule or method, often written with symbols or numbers
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher wrote the chemical formula on the board.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen kimyasal formülü tahtaya yazdı.

meanings.en: forward or out into view
meanings.exampleEn: The knight rode forth to meet the enemy.
meanings.exampleTr: Şövalye düşmanla karşılaşmak için ileri at sürdü.

meanings.en: a period of two weeks
meanings.exampleEn: We are going on holiday for a fortnight.
meanings.exampleTr: İki haftalığına tatile gidiyoruz.

meanings.en: lucky or having good things happen
meanings.exampleEn: We were fortunate to find a hotel so quickly.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar çabuk otel bulduğumuz için şanslıydık.

meanings.en: the base on which something is built or established
meanings.exampleEn: A strong education is the foundation of a good career.
meanings.exampleTr: Sağlam bir eğitim, iyi bir kariyerin temelidir.

meanings.en: a structure that sends water into the air for decoration
meanings.exampleEn: Children threw coins into the fountain in the square.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar meydandaki fıskiyeye bozuk para attılar.

meanings.en: a small broken piece of something
meanings.exampleEn: The archaeologists found a fragment of an ancient vase.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkeologlar antik bir vazonun bir parçasını buldular.

meanings.en: without limits or restrictions
meanings.exampleEn: Citizens can travel freely between the two countries.
meanings.exampleTr: Vatandaşlar iki ülke arasında serbestçe seyahat edebilir.

meanings.en: a machine or part of a fridge that keeps food frozen
meanings.exampleEn: Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
meanings.exampleTr: Dondurmayı tekrar dondurucuya koy.

meanings.en: extremely cold
meanings.exampleEn: It was freezing outside, so we stayed indoors.
meanings.exampleTr: Dışarısı buz gibiydi, bu yüzden içeride kaldık.

meanings.en: the rate at which something happens or is repeated
meanings.exampleEn: The frequency of earthquakes in the region is increasing.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgedeki depremlerin sıklığı artıyor.

meanings.en: happening often
meanings.exampleEn: He is a frequent visitor to our office.
meanings.exampleTr: O, ofisimize sık gelen biri.

meanings.en: often; many times
meanings.exampleEn: She frequently travels abroad for work.
meanings.exampleTr: İş için sık sık yurt dışına seyahat eder.

meanings.en: a first-year student at a high school or university
meanings.exampleEn: As a freshman, he found university life exciting.
meanings.exampleTr: Birinci sınıf öğrencisi olarak üniversite hayatını heyecan verici buldu.

meanings.en: the quality of being kind and pleasant to others
meanings.exampleEn: The friendliness of the staff made our stay enjoyable.
meanings.exampleTr: Personelin cana yakınlığı konaklamamızı keyifli kıldı.

meanings.en: a sudden feeling of fear
meanings.exampleEn: The loud noise gave me quite a fright.
meanings.exampleTr: O yüksek ses beni epeyce korkuttu.

meanings.en: a thin layer of ice that forms on cold surfaces
meanings.exampleEn: There was frost on the car windows this morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sabah araba camlarında kırağı vardı.

meanings.en: turned into ice or kept very cold to preserve
meanings.exampleEn: We bought some frozen vegetables for dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam yemeği için dondurulmuş sebze aldık.

meanings.en: feeling annoyed because you cannot achieve something
meanings.exampleEn: She felt frustrated when the computer kept crashing.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilgisayar sürekli çöktüğünde sinirli hissetti.

meanings.en: the feeling of being upset because you cannot do something
meanings.exampleEn: He shouted in frustration when he lost the game.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyunu kaybedince hayal kırıklığıyla bağırdı.

meanings.en: a shallow pan with a long handle used for frying food
meanings.exampleEn: Heat some oil in the frying pan before adding the eggs.
meanings.exampleTr: Yumurtaları eklemeden önce tavada biraz yağ ısıt.

meanings.en: a material such as gas or oil burned to produce energy
meanings.exampleEn: The price of fuel has risen sharply this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Yakıt fiyatı bu yıl keskin bir şekilde arttı.

meanings.en: the punctuation mark (.) used at the end of a sentence
meanings.exampleEn: Don't forget to put a full stop at the end of the sentence.
meanings.exampleTr: Cümlenin sonuna nokta koymayı unutma.
